article.title: Factors associated with work-life balance among emergency physicians, nurses, and paramedics: a systematic review.
article.authors: Pryba B, Wieczorek-Wójcik B, Pietrzak K
article.abstract: This systematic review aimed to identify and synthetically evaluate factors asso ciated with work-life balance (WLB) among emergency physicians, emergency nurses, and paramedics.
